connect_wallet_desc: BlockBite runs on {network}. Pick a wallet to start playing — Adventure mode is free to explore.
score_submitted: Your score has been submitted to the leaderboard
adv_lede: Place three pieces, clear full rows and columns, and keep going while a piece still fits.
adv_connect_desc: Adventure costs nothing: no tickets, no prizes. Connecting a wallet only puts your address on your scores. Nothing is charged.
scoring_chain: Clear on back-to-back moves for a chain: +20% at 2, +50% at 3, +100% at 5.
scoring_perfect: Empty the whole board: +5000 and ×10 on your next clear.
scoring_large: Pieces of 5 or more blocks: +25 per block.
tip_keys: Press 1, 2 or 3 to pick a piece. Esc puts it back.
tip_click: Tap or click the board to drop it.
tip_combo: One piece that finishes a row and a column counts as two lines.
tip_space: Leave a straight gap of 4 somewhere. Long bars need it.
ranked_cta_title: One board a day, own pieces every try
ranked_cta_body: 1 ticket = 1 attempt = {price} USDC, up to {attempts} attempts per UTC day; your best one counts. {daily}% of each day's prize vault goes to the daily top 10 and {monthly}% to the monthly top 10, ranked by the sum of each player's {days} best days.
box_more: {n} more picks until the odds go up
err_title: Something broke while loading this level.
err_body: Usually the browser ran short on memory. Trying again fixes it most of the time. If not, go back to the map.
goal_other: Goal: shown on the level card
